title: QuickStack SMB AI
text:
QuickStack SMB AI

notes:
Lead source: inbound self-serve signup from Product Hunt listing. Founder (Maya Chen) — early-stage dev tools startup focusing on embedding-based code search for SMB developer shops.

Key snippets from calls/emails: 
- 'We want to keep payments on card if low usage, but finance wants invoice once monthly spend > $5k.'
- 'Can you extend the free credits? Our POC hit limit during benchmarking.'
- 'Looking for predictable per-token costs; worried about surprise bills.'

Procurement flavor: procurement-lite. Wants simple path: credit-card first, invoice for committed spend. Interested in startup discount program or promotional extension.

Tech requirements & preferences:
- Hosted API preferred (no infra ops).
- Models: open-models acceptable; cost sensitivity drives interest in quantized variants and Redwood Optimize suggestions.
- Workload: chat UI for developer assistance (short prompts), embeddings for code search (high QPS but small vectors), re-ranking later.
- Targets: p50 latency ~<120ms for chat, embeddings throughput ~200 qps during tests, budget cap ~$1k/month to start.

Security: SSO/SAML desired but not blocker; needs basic audit logs and DPA for customer data. No air-gapped requirement.

Sales touches so far: Aisha intro, Diego technical review. Founder open to short POC (2 weeks) if credits extended.

Open items / Ask from Redwood: 
- Approve 30-day free credits extension (+$200) to complete embedding benchmark.
- Confirm invoice path and minimums: can we offer monthly invoice for <$5k with card-on-file backup?
- Provide startup discount docs and eligibility checklist.

Suggested playbook: push small startup package (extended credits + 10% startup discount for first 6 months), clear doc outlining CC vs invoice thresholds, link to quickstart repo. Keep friction low to convert to paid card first, escalate to invoice only when finance requests PO.

Staged next steps (choppy CRM language ok):
- Send credits extension + pricing email (Aisha) — due 2026-03-11.
- Attach startup discount T&Cs and example invoice flow.
- Schedule 30-min follow-up w/ founder & Diego week of 2026-03-15 to review POC results.

Notes: founder is pragmatic, values fast time-to-value. If POC shows cost predictability, high chance of convert to card billing and small monthly commit.
